description: Scans a verified-source EVM contract for proxy/admin pattern, owner type, and privileged functions (mint, pause, blacklist, upgrade, fees), then returns a risk verdict. Use for admin-power analysis; for a buy/sell honeypot test use `rug_honeypot_quick_check`, for a broader token screen use `token_due_diligence`; paid 0.55 USDC via x402.
